label: Procuring Entity name
validation: Non-null; matches the authorised Requisition
downstream_use: Invitation opening paragraph; TDS ITT1.1; Form of Tender; Certificate of Independent Tender Determination; Form SD1/SD2; Confidential Business Questionnaire; SCC GCC1.1(h); Section VIII forms

label: Procuring Entity address
validation: Non-null
example: Popo Road, Off Mombasa Road, Nairobi
downstream_use: Invitation opening paragraph (PE name/contract name block, COV-007)

label: PE contact office (clarification, submission and contract notices)
validation: Sourced from governed PE data, not free text
downstream_use: Invitation electronic-access paragraph, S11.1 item 5 (also covers the governed electronic-access/download particulars from COV-011 and COV-013, mapped to this existing key rather than a new one); TDS ITT6.1/6.5/49.1; Form of Tender Code of Ethics website reference; SCC GCC8.1 notices

label: Procurement method
validation: Must be Open Tender - Goods for template compatibility (S2)
downstream_use: TDS ITT1.1; Invitation method statement; template-compatibility check

label: Requirement title (defaults the Tender title)
validation: Used only as the default seed for tender.title, not rendered independently
example: Supply and delivery of ICT equipment
downstream_use: Seeds tender.title at Task 1; not separately rendered once tender.title is confirmed

label: Authorised quantity
validation: Goods row quantities must reconcile with this total
downstream_use: Quantity-reconciliation check against goods rows (S8.1); not printed as a standalone figure

label: Authorised value
validation: Scope/change-control check only; not disclosed unless required
downstream_use: Internal scope/change-control check; not rendered in supplier-facing text unless a specific clause requires disclosure

label: Expected delivery date (latest permitted)
validation: goods.latest_delivery_date must not be later than this date
downstream_use: Validation bound for goods.latest_delivery_date (S8.1); internal check, not separately printed

label: Approved related-service need (gates the related-services schedule)
validation: Determines whether Section V.2 and the service_rows loop render
downstream_use: Gates the service_rows loop and Section V.2 heading (S8.2)

label: Technical specification title
validation: Approved, controlled document must exist and be readable
downstream_use: Section V cover sheet naming the specification (S8.4); package_index.md

label: Technical specification version
validation: Must be present on the approved document
downstream_use: Section V cover sheet

label: Technical specification approval date
validation: Approved status and date must be present
downstream_use: Section V cover sheet; readiness check (S8.4/S16)

label: Technical specification publication filename
validation: Must match the file listed in package_index.md
downstream_use: Section V cover sheet; package_index.md cross-check

label: Technical specification SHA-256 digest
validation: Must match the published PDF's digest
downstream_use: Section V cover sheet; consistency check against the published PDF (S11.3)

label: Tender title
validation: Non-null; defaults from requisition.requirement_title but officer may edit
example: Supply and delivery of ICT equipment
downstream_use: Invitation heading; TDS ITT1.1; Form of Tender; Certificate of Independent Tender Determination; Form SD1/SD2; Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form

label: Tender issue date
validation: Non-null
downstream_use: Invitation publication date; TDS

label: Clarification deadline
validation: After issue date, before submission deadline
downstream_use: Invitation clarification paragraph; TDS ITT6.1

label: Submission deadline
validation: Non-null, after issue date and clarification deadline
downstream_use: Invitation submission-deadline paragraph; TDS ITT21.1; feeds tender.opening_datetime generation

label: Tender validity in days
validation: Non-null, multiple of seven
downstream_use: TDS ITT17.1; feeds tender.validity_date generation; Form of Tender

label: Tender security treatment
validation: Fixed to 'Tender Security' for Version 1.0; the Tender-Securing Declaration path is excluded (open_issues.md Pass 2 item 7)
downstream_use: Invitation security summary; TDS ITT18.1; determines that the Form of Tender Security (not the Declaration) is the applicable form

label: Tender security currency
validation: Should equal tender.currency unless otherwise justified
downstream_use: Invitation security summary; TDS ITT18.1; Form of Tender Security prefill

label: Tender security amount
validation: Non-null, positive
downstream_use: Invitation security summary; TDS ITT18.1; Form of Tender Security prefill

label: Pre-tender meeting held (Yes/No)
downstream_use: Gates the pre-tender-meeting paragraph in the Invitation/TDS (ITT 6.2-6.3)

label: Pre-tender meeting date/location/details
validation: Required only when tender.pre_tender_meeting.enabled is TRUE
downstream_use: Invitation/TDS ITT6.2-6.3 when enabled

label: Goods description (per row)
validation: Plain, supplier-readable
downstream_use: Section V.1 goods schedule row; Form of Tender clause (d) conformity summary; Price Schedule row identity

label: Quantity (per row)
validation: Total across rows must reconcile with requisition.authorised_quantity
downstream_use: Section V.1 goods schedule row; Price Schedule row

label: Unit (per row)
validation: From the governed unit list
downstream_use: Section V.1 goods schedule row

label: Final destination (per row)
validation: Required
downstream_use: Section V.1 goods schedule row; TDS ITT13.8

label: Latest delivery date (per row)
validation: Not later than requisition.expected_delivery_date
downstream_use: Section V.1 goods schedule row; SCC delivery/warranty rows

label: Minimum warranty (per row)
validation: Required for this pattern
downstream_use: Section V.1 goods schedule row; TDS ITT15.4; SCC GCC28.3 warranty rows

label: Related service description (per row)
validation: Consistent with the Requisition
downstream_use: Section V.2 related-services schedule row

label: Related service quantity (per row)
downstream_use: Section V.2 related-services schedule row

label: Related service unit (per row)
validation: From the governed unit list
downstream_use: Section V.2 related-services schedule row

label: Place of performance (per row)
downstream_use: Section V.2 related-services schedule row

label: Completion date (per row)
validation: Within the authorised delivery boundary
downstream_use: Section V.2 related-services schedule row

label: Tender currency
validation: Exactly one currency (S2/S6)
downstream_use: TDS/Price Schedule header; ITT14 currency clause

label: Fixed-price confirmation
validation: Must equal TRUE for Version 1.0 - price adjustment not supported (S6); the rendered clauses (COV-129 TDS ITT13.5, COV-250 SCC GCC15.1) state this as fixed wording once confirmed
downstream_use: TDS ITT13.5/17.3; SCC GCC15.1 (rendered as 'prices shall not be adjustable')

label: Tax display treatment
validation: One of 'Shown separately' / 'Included'
downstream_use: Price Schedule form header and total presentation

label: Manufacturer authorisation required
downstream_use: TDS ITT16.2(a); gates inclusion of the Manufacturer's Authorization Form (COV-230)

label: Datasheet or brochure required
downstream_use: Evidence checklist entry

label: Comparable supply experience required (if justified)
validation: Only set TRUE with a stated justification
downstream_use: Gates Section III.4.2(b) qualification criterion

label: Number of comparable supply contracts required
downstream_use: Section III.4.2(b) qualification criterion

label: Period over which comparable contracts are counted (years)
downstream_use: Section III.4.2(b) qualification criterion

label: After-sales support evidence required (if justified)
downstream_use: TDS ITT16.2(b); gates the after-sales evidence checklist entry

label: Stated after-sales support evidence required
validation: Must state what evidence proves the requirement
downstream_use: Evidence checklist entry

label: Additional evidence item required
validation: Only one short additional item permitted
downstream_use: Gates the additional-evidence checklist entry

label: Additional evidence item description
validation: Must state the requirement it proves
downstream_use: Evidence checklist entry

label: The visible published requirement the additional evidence proves
validation: Must reference a requirement actually published elsewhere in the Tender; an unexplained item fails curation review (S9.3)
downstream_use: Evidence checklist entry

label: Payment timing (descriptive rule)
validation: Must not offer an advance-payment option (fixed at 0%, open_issues.md Pass 2 item 9)
example: Within 30 days after delivery, inspection, acceptance and a valid invoice
downstream_use: SCC GCC16.1

label: Payment period in days
downstream_use: SCC GCC16.1

label: Performance Security required
downstream_use: TDS ITT47.3; SCC GCC18.1

label: Performance Security percentage
downstream_use: TDS ITT47.3; SCC GCC18.1; Form No. 5 prefill

label: Performance Security form variant
validation: Fixed to 'Unconditional Demand Bank Guarantee' for Version 1.0; the competing Performance Bond variant (Form No. 6) is not published (COV-282)
downstream_use: SCC GCC18.3; determines which Section VIII performance-security form is published

label: Delay damages rate per week (%)
validation: Within released limits
downstream_use: SCC GCC27.1

label: Delay damages cap (%)
validation: Within released limits
downstream_use: SCC GCC27.1

label: Inspection and acceptance office/location
downstream_use: Section V.5 inspections and tests; SCC GCC26.1/26.2

label: Contract contact office
validation: Must be a governed office, not a private contact (S10)
downstream_use: SCC GCC8.1 contract notices

label: Tender reference
validation: Unique per the released naming rule
downstream_use: Cover page; Invitation; TDS; all forms

label: Tender opening date/time
validation: Equals tender.submission_deadline under the immediate electronic opening rule
downstream_use: Invitation opening paragraph; TDS ITT24.1

label: Tender/security validity date
validation: Derived from tender.submission_deadline, tender.validity_days and the official extra period
downstream_use: Form of Tender Security expiry prefill

label: Bank Guarantee tender security expiry date
validation: Computed as tender.validity_date + thirty (30) calendar days per ITT 18.4; never officer-entered
downstream_use: Form of Tender Security - Option 1 (Demand Bank Guarantee) expiry clause

label: Insurance Guarantee tender security expiry date
validation: Computed as tender.validity_date + twenty-eight (28) calendar days per the Insurance Guarantee form's own terms; never officer-entered
downstream_use: Form of Tender Security - Option 2 (Insurance Guarantee) expiry clause

label: Plan Item reference
validation: Internal lineage only
downstream_use: Internal audit/lineage record; not rendered in invitation_to_tender.html or complete_tender.html supplier-facing text (S7.1: 'not unnecessary public text')

label: Requisition reference
validation: Internal lineage only
downstream_use: Internal audit/lineage record; not rendered in invitation_to_tender.html or complete_tender.html supplier-facing text (S7.1: 'not unnecessary public text')

label: Goods and delivery schedule (repeating rows: description, quantity, unit, destination, latest delivery date, minimum warranty)
validation: One row per authorised goods line; total quantity reconciles with the Requisition; item number is rendered via loop.index, not a named key; the row also carries a static 'Offered delivery date' column left blank for later supplier completion (not a Jinja value in this release)
example: Business laptops / 25 each / KEBS Coast Region Office, Mombasa / 30 Dec 2026 / 36 months
downstream_use: Section V.1 goods schedule; Form of Tender clause (d) conformity summary; Price Schedule (Goods) row skeleton; SCC GCC28.3 warranty rows

label: Related services and completion schedule (repeating rows: description, quantity, unit, place of performance, completion date)
validation: Rendered only when requisition.related_services_authorized is TRUE; service number is rendered via loop.index, not a named key; supplier-price column left blank (not a Jinja value in this release)
example: Installation and configuration / 1 lot / KEBS Coast Region Office, Mombasa / 15 Dec 2026
downstream_use: Section V.2 related-services schedule; Price and Completion Schedule (Related Services) row skeleton; SCC GCC25.2 incidental services

label: Platform name
validation: Fixed governed value; not officer-editable
downstream_use: Invitation to Tender S11.1 item 4; TDS ITT 1.2(a) e-Procurement system identity (complete_tender.html)

label: Platform public URL
validation: Fixed governed value; reused for both the e-Procurement system address and electronic document access per Gate C decision - no separate publication-URL field
downstream_use: Invitation to Tender electronic-access paragraph (S11.1 item 4); TDS ITT 1.2(a) e-Procurement system address (complete_tender.html)

label: Authorised official name
validation: Sourced from the final Tender approval record; not a wet signature or officer-entered field
downstream_use: Invitation to Tender accountability block (S11.1 item 8)

label: Authorised official title
validation: Sourced from the final Tender approval record
downstream_use: Invitation to Tender accountability block (S11.1 item 8)

label: Tender approval date
validation: Sourced from the final Tender approval record
downstream_use: Invitation to Tender accountability block (S11.1 item 8)

label: Tender approval / authentication reference
validation: Sourced from the final Tender approval record; replaces a wet-ink signature
downstream_use: Invitation to Tender accountability block (S11.1 item 8)
